title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: Every firm exporting the controlled alloy holds a licence. Some licensed firms export no controlled alloy. Norval exports the controlled alloy. The passage gives no information about Norval’s sales volume.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.

provenance.notes: Original fictional scenario written for this expansion, not adapted from an official question.
